position: Project and Quality Administrator Work From Home Dayshift
description:
We are seeking a Project and Quality Administrator (Quality Systems) to provide project administration and data coordination support across multiple active projects. The role will maintain accurate project records, coordinate quality documentation, monitor outstanding tasks, prepare reports, and support audit readiness while working closely with internal teams to ensure project information remains complete, accurate, and up to date.

  • Provide project administration and data coordination support across multiple active projects.
  • Gather, maintain, and update project information, quality records, and supporting documentation.
  • Manage project data and assigned tasks using Deltek, Jira, CRM, and other project management systems.
  • Prepare and distribute reports, dashboards, and project performance information using available data.
  • Monitor outstanding documentation, actions, deadlines, and quality requirements, proactively following up with stakeholders.
  • Maintain accurate, complete, and auditable records to support quality assurance processes and audit readiness.
  • Identify missing or inaccurate information, resolve discrepancies, escalate issues, and support continuous improvement of project workflows.
  • Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in data coordination, project administration, project coordination, quality systems administration, or a similar role.
  • Hands-on experience with Deltek is essential.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft 365, including data management, reporting, and documentation.
